externalServices: Provider, Google Play and Paddle replies were simulated. No live purchase or production Firebase write was performed.
limits: Actual microphone transcription accuracy and latency were not measured against a live speech service.
Physical iOS and Android devices and the native APK were not tested; the Android project is not present in this repository.
A new GitHub upload must also be deployed to Netlify for the updated backend to run.
Existing credentials, merchant approvals, Play product activation and server-account permissions must be configured in their consoles.
Passing automated checks is not a guarantee that no defect can exist.
changedBehaviors: Responsive story layout follows the available app width.
The first five new Play products are monthly subscriptions; Crown and historical one-time ownership remain lifetime.
Play subscriptions are verified and canceled server-side; expired periods cannot supply quota benefits.
A fixed source language configures the actual speech recognizer and supported fallback engines. Automatic mode detects supported languages.
Existing vocabulary and local-model caches are preserved.
